data.name: Snakebite Striker
data.description: With her lightning quickness and guile, a snakebite striker keeps her foes' attention focused on her, because any one of her feints might be an actual attack. By giving up some of a brawler's versatility, she increases her damage potential and exposes opponents to deadly and unexpected strikes.
